topic: What power allocation trade-offs arise from differing scan losses between quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes for multi-beam satellite systems?
consensus_response: Quasi-TEM modes offer lower scan losses, enabling higher EIRP and better signal quality, but require complex beamforming. Quasi-TE1 modes simplify implementation with higher losses, trading off performance for ease of management. Power allocation trade-offs depend on balancing complexity, interference management, and system capacity.
reference_context: SatCom systems optimize power allocation via techniques like spatial power combining, frequency reuse, and beamforming to manage interference and capacity.
